plosives.description: Bilabial and plosive stops; maximal lip closure and release.
plosives.text: Peter bought a big purple balloon by the bumpy bridge. Bobby packed pepper, pickles and puffed pastry into a deep paper bag. People keep telling Papa to buy better puppets, but Papa prefers plain plastic ones.

sibilants.description: Sibilants and fricatives; sustained teeth exposure.
sibilants.text: She sells seashells by the shore, and the fifth thief thought this was thrilling. Sixty seven soft cushions shifted south of the shallow ship. Fresh fish, sharp cheese, and thick frosted shortcake sat on the shelf.

open-vowels.description: Open and low vowels; wide jaw excursion.
open-vowels.text: Ah, awesome. Oscar always orders octopus on Saturdays. Arthur saw a large hawk hovering over the tall barn as father called out across the yard. Almost all of the artists argued about the odd abstract art.

rounded.description: Rounded vowels and glides; lip protrusion.
rounded.text: You would woo wooden Wanda, who wooed you too. Would rumours move through the whole room, or would you choose to lose them? Blue balloons flew through the moody gloom, looming over two new rooms.

numbers-rapid.description: Dense numeric articulation; fast consonant transitions.
numbers-rapid.text: Seven, sixteen, twenty three, forty eight, ninety nine, one hundred and two. Multiply thirty seven by fifty four, subtract eighteen, then divide by twelve. Call five five five, zero one nine three, extension sixty six, before quarter past eight.

conversational.description: Natural prosody with questions and pauses.
conversational.text: Are you really going there today? Why would anyone do that. Honestly, I think we should wait, talk it through properly, and then decide together. It is not urgent. But if you insist, well, I suppose we could leave early tomorrow morning instead.
